title: Badges Check
description: Predict how earned/total progress maps to a badge tier's status.

questions.prompt: What does a HackerRank skill badge track?

options.text: Cumulative solved-challenge count in a practice track

questions.explanation: Badges accumulate progress from solved challenges in a domain track over time, not from one attempt.

questions.prompt: A badge tier shows earned = 19, total = 20. What is its status?
questions.explanation: Status is only complete when earned equals total exactly; 19/20 is still in-progress.

questions.prompt: What happens once earned reaches total for a badge tier?

options.text: The badge is complete and progress resets toward the next tier
The badge disappears from the profile
You must retake a proctored test to keep it

questions.explanation: Completing a tier resets the progress counters toward the next, higher tier of the same badge.
Badges only track progress toward completion; there is no fail outcome the way a certification attempt has one.

questions.prompt: A badge progress fraction should always be printed as:
questions.explanation: The convention is earned first, then total, separated by a slash, regardless of completion status.
